other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in target encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target aggregations (e.g., mean of the target variable grouped by categorical features) on the training set and merges them directly back into the training set without using out-of-fold encoding or excluding the current row. This causes the target value of a training instance to be included in its own features, leading to severe overfitting.

summary: The agent provides a structurally robust solution with strong feature engineering, including well-chosen multi-week lags (>= 51 weeks) that correctly avoid test-set missingness, and a proper temporal validation split. However, a critical flaw exists in the target encoding implementation: historical sales statistics are computed on the training set and merged directly back into it without out-of-fold splitting, causing severe target leakage. Additionally, stochastic models are evaluated only once rather than being averaged over multiple seeds.
